sections.p: DriveFix connects drivers with parts suppliers, mechanics and tow drivers in Algeria. DriveFix is not the seller of the parts nor the provider of the repair or towing service.
Your Algerian mobile number is your login. Suppliers, mechanics and tow drivers are checked by an administrator before they can receive requests.
Prices are set by each partner and shown before you confirm. Payment is cash on delivery by default. The online payment page is a demo: no real money moves.
Used parts must always be labelled as used, with their condition and warranty.
You can leave one review per delivered order or finished booking. Abusive reviews are removed by moderation.
Your name, phone number, language, and the orders, bookings and tow requests you make. Passwords are stored hashed and never shown.
Your location is used only during an SOS request, to find the nearest truck and show the live tracking.
A partner sees only what is needed to serve you: your name and phone number for the order, booking or tow.
You can ask to see, correct or delete your data by contacting support.
